chunks: Abu Khadijah narrated from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:
"The one who spends the night alone in the house is a devil; two are a gathering of whisperers; and three bring companionship."

key_terms.شَيْطَانٌ: a devil; here expressing blameworthy isolation
key_terms.لُمَةٌ: a small gathering or close company

ai.seo_question: What does Imam Abu Abdullah عليه السلام say about spending the night alone in a house?
ai.summary: This hadith discourages spending the night alone and highlights the value of human companionship. It portrays greater social company as a source of comfort and familiarity, encouraging shared presence rather than isolation.
